books.title: Yesteryear
books.author: Caro Claire Burke
books.description: A woman returns to her small-town roots to settle her grandmother's estate — and uncovers the family secrets that were buried alongside it.

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: Ryland Grace wakes up alone on a spacecraft with no memory of how he got there — and realises the fate of Earth rests entirely on his shoulders.

books.title: The Correspondent
books.author: Virginia Evans
books.description: Letters from someone Sybil Van Antwerp used to know pull her back toward a past she buried — and a forgiveness she isn't sure she can give.

books.title: Theo of Golden
books.author: Allen Levi
books.description: A wandering man visits a small Southern town, trading pencil portraits of residents for the stories of their lives — and unexpectedly finds his own.

books.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl
books.author: Matt Dinniman
books.description: A Coast Guard vet named Carl and his ex-girlfriend's cat, Princess Donut, are trapped in a deadly fantasy dungeon that has replaced the surface of Earth.

books.title: Rites of the Starling
books.author: Devney Perry
books.description: When a forbidden tournament demands she prove her worth in battle, a young woman discovers that the greatest danger isn't the competition — it's the ruthless champion she's falling for.

books.title: Hope Rises
books.author: David Baldacci
books.description: David Baldacci's latest thriller sends a determined protagonist into a high-stakes investigation where the truth is buried under layers of deception and the cost of failure is unthinkable.

books.title: The Housemaid
books.author: Freida McFadden
books.description: A woman with a desperate secret takes a live-in housekeeping job for a wealthy family — and quickly discovers that the perfect home hides something deeply sinister.

books.title: The Housemaid's Secret
books.author: Freida McFadden
books.description: The housekeeper returns — and the next family she works for is hiding something even darker than the last.

books.title: Starside
books.author: Alex Aster
books.description: In a world where swords have magic and power must be claimed rather than inherited, one woman rises through a deadly competition that will decide the fate of everything.

books.title: Purple State
books.author: Dana Perino
books.description: From former White House press secretary Dana Perino, a novel set against the backdrop of American politics — exploring what it means to find common ground in a divided country.

books.title: A Woman's Place
books.author: Danielle Steel
books.description: Danielle Steel's latest novel follows a woman navigating extraordinary circumstances with the grace and resolve that define the author's most beloved characters.

books.title: Game On
books.author: Navessa Allen
books.description: The #1 national bestseller — a dark, addictive romance about two strangers whose dangerous cat-and-mouse game becomes impossible to walk away from.

books.title: Paradox
books.author: Douglas Preston and Aletheia Preston
books.description: A high-octane thriller from bestselling author Douglas Preston and Aletheia Preston that plunges readers into a scientific mystery with world-altering stakes.

books.title: My Husband's Wife
books.author: Alice Feeney
books.description: A woman finds her marriage unravelling when her husband's past suddenly reappears — and she realises she may never have known him at all.

books.title: Dear Debbie
books.author: Freida McFadden
books.description: An advice columnist with a perfect public image starts using her column to settle private scores — with increasingly dangerous results.

books.title: This Kingdom Will Not Kill Me
books.author: Ilona Andrews
books.description: When Maggie wakes up cold and naked in a gutter, she has no memory — only the certainty that the ruthless kingdom around her will demand everything she has.

books.title: Betrayal
books.author: Tom Bower
books.description: Britain's leading investigative biographer examines the royal family's most divisive chapter — Prince Harry and Meghan's dramatic departure from the Crown.

books.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
books.author: Oscar Wilde
books.description: Oscar Wilde's timeless gothic novel about a beautiful young man who sells his soul for eternal youth, watching his portrait age and corrupt as he indulges every desire.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
books.author: J.K. Rowling
books.description: As Voldemort's power grows, Harry delves into the Dark Lord's past — and learns the shattering secret at the heart of his final confrontation in the penultimate Harry Potter novel.

books.title: News from Dublin
books.author: Colm Tóibín
books.description: A luminous story collection from the author of Brooklyn — intimate and precise portraits of people shaped by what they cannot say and what they cannot forgive.

books.title: Heated Rivalry
books.author: Rachel Reid
books.description: Two rival hockey stars have been secretly in love for years — and the playoffs are about to make keeping that secret impossible.

books.title: King of Gluttony
books.author: Ana Huang
books.description: The latest in Ana Huang's Kings of Sin series — a dark, steamy romance in which power and desire collide, and every temptation comes with a price.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
books.author: J.K. Rowling
books.description: Harry's fifth year at Hogwarts brings the Ministry of Magic's dangerous denial, the founding of Dumbledore's Army, and the prophecy that binds him to Voldemort forever.

books.title: The Night We Met
books.author: Abby Jimenez
books.description: Two strangers meet during a chance encounter and forge a connection neither expected — until the complications of their real lives test whether one perfect night can lead somewhere lasting.
